<function name="GetDockPadding" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the docked padding of the panel. (set by <page>Panel:DockPadding</page>)</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Left padding.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Top padding.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Right padding.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Bottom padding.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
